track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

zetaris.description: Zetaris serves as the federated data layer, querying disparate outpatient EHR records, diagnostic labs, and urgent care encounters in-situ via Spark SQL REST API without centralizing sensitive PHI.
queries: SELECT * FROM labs.metabolic_panel WHERE patient_id = :id ORDER BY test_date DESC

engines_used.description: Maintains 3-tier hierarchical memory (Long-Term Semantic, Short-Term Episodic, and Working Memory) across patient encounters, executes automated conflict detection (NSAID + ACE-inhibitor contraindication), and logs immutable audit trails to the Trust Ledger.

nvidia.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (hosted endpoints connected through Meterless Nightshift) powers the multi-step clinical hypothesis verification, metric delta calculations, and structured caregiver visit-prep briefing.

sample_mode.description: Runs full multi-agent logic on curated clinical datasets with zero external credentials or network dependencies.
